issues.issue: Did the officer's failure to consider section 221 of the IRPR make the refusal unreasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Officer had to consider s.221 IRPR, which allows a study permit after six months; ignoring it made the decision unreasonable.
issues.respondent_position: Applicant never raised s.221 before the officer and did not admit substantial non-compliance, so no duty to consider it.
issues.result_quote: I find the Officer’s failure to consider section 221 did not render the Decision unreasonable.
